summary: Build 18 targeted compliance sweep — legal pages on LIVE Fly.dev backend + preview frontend smoke. Backend (Python requests against https://vaultpop-api.fly.dev): 13/13 pytest tests PASS in 1.31s. Verified: (1) GET /privacy returns 200 text/html, no-auth, contains 'Privacy Policy', 'Last updated: July 30, 2026', Google AdMob, Apple, fictional in-game items, support@vaultpop.app, footer links href="/terms" and href="/support". (2) GET /terms returns 200 text/html, no-auth, contains 'Terms of Use', 'Last updated: July 30, 2026', fictional/no real-world value language, 'VaultPass Plus' section, Apple-specific terms, footer links href="/privacy" and href="/support". No new react-native issues.
